name: List forms
description: Call this when you need to retrieve a paginated list of forms of a specific type (e.g., subscription) from the Brevo Forms API. Use the "Get form details" action instead if you need information about a single form identified by its ID.

type.description: The category of forms to retrieve.

limit.description: Maximum number of forms to return in the response.

offset.description: Number of forms to skip before starting to collect the result set.

forms.description: Array of form objects matching the request criteria.

items.description: A form representation (fields are not documented).

totalRecords.description: Total number of forms that match the query, irrespective of pagination.
